'''January 2000 Voorschoten tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Voorschoten, Netherlands on 9 January 2000. [[Bart Ouwehand]] won it. It is known from Johan van der Meer's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d186">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-01-18-voorschoten-the-netherlands-9-jan-2000d186/ voorschoten-the-netherlands-9-jan-2000], DeckTech (Johan "Johan" van der Meer, 18 January 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-01-18-voorschoten-the-netherlands-9-jan-2000d186/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 9 January 2000
* '''Site:''' Voorschoten, Netherlands
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Players:''' 14
* '''Winner:''' [[Bart Ouwehand]]
